verdict.rationale: Dover documents a self-serve export of candidate data to CSV, an open format, from Settings → Data Export. Signed offers can also be downloaded as PDFs. However, the evidence shows only candidate data being exported, not all account data (jobs, interview feedback, notes, notetaker transcripts, analytics), so a complete exit is not shown. missing for 10: documented export of all data types beyond candidates, a full-account or bulk archive export, independent or hands-on confirmation of export completeness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your candidate data to a CSV from **Settings → Data Export**.
you can download the signed offer as a PDF
